subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

I are dancing with my husband at my sister’s wedding.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb "**are**" with the subject "**I**."
 
• The correct verb to use with the subject "I" is "**am**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**I am dancing**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I** am** dancing with my husband at my sister's wedding."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "husband at my"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "sister's wedding"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "with my"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
